body: J. Cole’s The Fall-Off Tour came full circle in North Carolina, starting and ending the North American leg in the state that raised him. Cole has always shown how much he loves giving back to and honoring his home state, making the end of this leg an especially meaningful moment. From Fayetteville to the world stage, Cole continues to carry North Carolina with him, using moments like these to celebrate the people and place that helped shape his story.
